The plan removes head **6**, not head 5. Rows 3840–4607 (head 5, per `768*5..768*5+767`) are the ones the spec requires dropped, but the plan's `query_key_value` copies keep `[0:4608]` and `[5376:6144]` — i.e. it drops rows 4608–5375 (head 6) while keeping head 5's rows 3840–4607, violating Required-result clauses 1 and 2 (which require keeping rows `0..3839, 4608..6143`). The same off-by-one-head error repeats in `dense.weight`: the plan keeps columns `[0:1536]` and `[1792:2048]` (dropping head 6's columns 1536–1791) instead of the spec's required `0..1279, 1536..2047` (dropping head 5's columns 1280–1535), violating clause 3. The shape asserts still pass (shapes are head-count-agnostic), so the plan would run to completion and satisfy the "Required checks," but the actual tensor content is wrong and will fail the hidden bit-exact grading.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
